hero.title: Military
hero.subtitle: Conflicts between orderly armies lining up to face each other on the field of battle, with definite outcomes determined by defeating an enemy, seem to be a thing of the past. In the modern world, armed forces and the conflicts they engage in are more complex than ever. Under these circumstances even defining the objective has to be reevaluated. Conflicts occur within a global web of economic and social interactions and the objectives are defined by the ongoing relationships that can be achieved. NECSI has written several papers covering various facets of modern military conflict.

contentBlocks.heading: Modern military actions are highly complex encounters between hidden, distributed networks of individuals. Urban conflict, terrorist networks, cybersecurity, and peacekeeping demand new strategies, organizational structures and capabilities.
